# BBN helium table

`sBBN_2025.dat`: primordial helium mass fraction Y_He as a function of omega_b and Delta N = N_eff - 3.044, computed
with PArthENoPE v3.0 (neutron lifetime 878.4 s), as distributed with CLASS v3.3+ (`external/bbn/sBBN_2025.dat`, the
CLASS default). Y_He is the He-4 mass fraction of all baryons, as used by CLASS and by our recombination code. Used
when `Yp_bbn = true` (src/BBN.h). References: Gariazzo et al. (arXiv:2103.05027) for PArthENoPE 3.0; Lesgourgues &
the CLASS team for the table format.
